title: 2 Chinese arrested over alleged illegal copper ore transport in Cebu
summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two Chinese nationals were arrested after authorities intercepted two trucks carrying about 47 tons of unprocessed copper ore allegedly transported using falsified permits at…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two Chinese nationals were arrested after authorities intercepted two trucks carrying about 47 tons of unprocessed copper ore allegedly transported using falsified permits at Pier 4 in Cebu City on Wednesday, Oct. 28. The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said the operation resulted in the seizure of approximately 47,040 kilograms
